options.description: Plumb offers at most one idea per step, and studies come as a Markdown page or a page with diagrams; no video option. Recommended: Your words did not mention a cap or video, so the simplest option is one idea per step with Markdown and diagrams, which keeps the suggestions from overwhelming you while you work.
options.label: One per step, Markdown and diagrams only (Recommended)

options.description: Plumb can suggest several ideas per step, with no video option.
options.label: No cap, Markdown and diagrams only

options.description: Plumb can suggest several ideas per step and offers a video depth, shown as unavailable until video studies exist.
options.label: No cap, include video
